messages:
maya: Quick async check — onboarding status for two open models: `orca-mini-7b` and `mosaic-14b-v2`. Need license clearance, perf profiles, and owner signoff before we flip the catalog flag. Target canary: Mon 2026-02-09. @ajay are you the primary owner for orca?

ajay: Yup I can own orca-mini-7b. License scan started, pinged legal for the non-commercial clause question. I posted PR for model card updates: https://git.internal/r/redwood/models/pulls/452 — needs one more review. :eyes:

cheng: Perf quick notes for initial profile (seq=512, temp=0.8):
```
orca-mini-7b: p50=46ms/token, p95=120ms/token (g4dn-like), throughput=320 tok/s
mosaic-14b-v2: p50=82ms/token, p95=210ms/token, throughput=160 tok/s
```
Quantized runs (int8) drop p50 ~10-15% but p95 stays similar. I’ll attach perf traces to the PR.

maya: thanks — can you add the kernel/quant flags you used so ops can reproduce? also list which hardware region these were run in.

cheng: ran on dedicated eu-west-1 g5x2 and us-west-2 a10g. Kernel flags: `--fused-attn=autotune --kv-cache=sharded` and int8 via `--qat=true`. Will include exact run script in the PR.

evan: From PM/launch side: docs + quickstart need 2 things before canary: 1) confirmed license ok, 2) example prompts + eval set uploaded. DevEx said they can get examples out in 48h once model cards are final.

maya: license-bot — status on mosaic-14b-v2 scan? :thumbsup:

license-bot: mosaic-14b-v2 -> NOTICE: third-party weights include Apache-2.0; auxiliary tokenizer has mixed MIT/python-license files flagged. Action required: legal review recommended.

ajay: noted. I added a legal review ticket (LEGAL-1187) and tagged @maria-legal. I can hold orca canary if mosaic isn't cleared — or we can split rollout by model.

maya: prefer split rollout. Launch orca-mini-7b canary on Mon if PR & perf artifacts are in and legal hasn't blocked orca. Mosaic can be added after LEG review.

cheng: +1 for split rollout. I'll open a tiny baseline eval for orca and assign to QA, should be done by end of day Friday.

maya: ownership matrix for the catalog page: @ajay owner (model card + infra), @cheng perf, @evan docs/PM, me coordinating rollout. If anyone wants to reassign speak up now.

ajay: quick ping for reviewers on PR #452 — @sam and @lena can you take a look tomorrow? small changes: model card + inference example.

evan: noted, I'll block time for release notes + announcement draft once canary passes basic smoke tests.

maya: perfect — summary next steps: (1) ajay finish PR + legal follow-up (2) cheng upload perf traces & run evals (3) devex produce examples (4) I’ll schedule canary toggle and monitor. Check-ins here; call only if blockers. :rocket:
